newsitem.title: KUWAIT: KUWAIT INDEX RISES 10.6 POINTS TO 1,900.4.
newsitem.headline: KUWAIT INDEX RISES 10.6 POINTS TO 1,900.4.

text.p: The Kuwait share index recovered some of last week's losses, rising 10.6 points to 1,900.4 in the week to Wednesday, an official report said on Thursday.
Kuwait Finance House was the week's biggest loser, dropping 50 fils to 720, the Kuwait Stock Exchange report showed. There 1,000 fils to the dinar ($3.345).
Finance House hit a record 790 fils in December.
The index had dropped by 15.8 points the previous week.

This week's largest gainers were in the industrial sector with Shuaiba Paper Products Company soaring 110 fils to 610 and Kuwait Metal Collecting and Shredding Co. rising 100 fils to 610 after hitting a high of 660.
The daily average for value of traded shares rose to 18.5 million dinars this week from 16.5 million while volume increased to a daily average of 65.1 million shares from 52.5 million.
Trading in the 12 listed investment firms dominated the week with a total value of 44.47 million dinars in 3,265 deals involving 181.5 million shares.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest through mutual funds.
